result:
This looks solid. The implementation is complete:

**Summary of changes:**
- `src/config/constants.ts` — added `DELETED_WORKSPACE_RETENTION_DAYS`
- `src/types/permission.ts` / `src/lib/permissions.ts` — added `org:restore` (owner-only)
- `src/types/event.ts` — added `organization.deleted` / `organization.restored` to `TaskflowEventMap`
- `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `activity-labels.ts` — added the two new audit actions everywhere the existing ones are accepted
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` — records audit rows for the two new events
- `src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts` — added `restoreOrg`, `listOrgIdsArchivedBefore`, and `purgeOrganization` (deletes every row belonging to the workspace across all tables, nulls out pointing sessions)
- `src/server/services/organization-service.ts` — `deleteOrganization` now guards against double-delete (`AlreadyArchivedError`) and publishes `organization.deleted`; added `restoreOrganization(userId, orgId)` implementing the NotFound/PermissionDenied/window/no-op rules and publishing `organization.restored`
- Jobs (`cleanup-archived-job`, `overdue-issue-job`, `trial-expiry-job`, `usage-rollup-job`, `webhook-delivery-job`) now skip/fail-appropriately for deleted workspaces; the cleanup job also purges workspaces past the retention window
- `notification-service.ts`'s `notify()` and `invitation-service.ts`'s `acceptInvitation()` now no-op / throw `NotFoundError` for deleted workspaces

Verified with a throwaway test (since removed) covering delete→restore, permission/window/non-member edge cases, purge removing all rows, and the invitation/notification/webhook suppression — plus the full existing suite (617 tests) and `tsc --noEmit`/`eslint` all pass clean.
